data.name: Idle Sailor
data.detailed_description:
Idle Sailor is a relaxing idle adventure where you captain a small sailboat, unlock famous destinations around the world, and fund your journey by livestreaming your travels.

Sail through different regions, snap underwater photos of unique fish, and grow your audience run by run.
Use your earnings to open new routes, discover more cities, and track down rare species hidden across the globe.
You can restart your voyage to claim permanent upgrades—speeding up progress and making each run more rewarding than the last.

Features

  • 26 world destinations, each with its own waters and exclusive fish to uncover.

  • 100+ fish species to discover, photograph, and add to your collection.

  • Idle sailing mixed with quick underwater photo sessions, blending hands-off progress with satisfying bursts of interaction.

  • Permanent upgrade progression, letting you restart voyages with stronger bonuses every run.
